title: Knowledge Object Schema V1
description: Canonical schema for a Knowledge Object — the unified representation of any entity stored in the Knowledge-Memory Authority system. Covers Evidence, Memory, and Receipt records.

object_id.description: Unique stable ID. Format: {prefix}_{uuid_hex}. Prefixes: evidence_, memory_, receipt_.

mission_id.description: Parent mission ID. Null for global/system objects.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of canonical content for integrity verification.

envelope_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the full integrity envelope (identity + metadata + payload).

idempotency_key.description: Client-supplied key for idempotent write semantics.

source_event_id.description: ID of the event that produced this object.

trace_id.description: Distributed trace identifier linking this object to its originating request chain.

provenance.description: Origin descriptor: runtime, human, import, migration, recovery.

status.description: Lifecycle status. committed/verified = canonical. candidate = awaiting review. conflict = requires resolution. superseded = replaced by newer version.

superseded_by.description: Object ID of the record that supersedes this one. Present only when status is 'superseded'.

confidence.description: Confidence score. 1.0 = verified by direct evidence. <1.0 = inferred or indirect evidence. <0.8 = candidate only.

verified.description: Whether this object has passed integrity verification.

canonical.description: Whether this object is the canonical version. Only one canonical object per logical key.
